National Quantum Mission (NQM): Advancing Quantum Computing and Communications in India

Division: Frontier & Futuristic Technologies Date: August 25, 2024 Budget: Rs. 6,003 Crore

The Union Cabinet approved the National Quantum Mission (NQM) with a total outlay of Rs. 6,003.65 crore over eight years.

The mission targets the development of intermediate-scale quantum computers with 50-1000 physical qubits in 8 years in various platforms like superconducting and photonic technology.

Four Thematic Hubs (T-Hubs)

  • Quantum Computing
  • Quantum Communication
  • Quantum Sensing & Metrology
  • Quantum Materials & Devices
